title: Acting
summary: The agent changes the app when the user asks, through actions the product defines.
description: An action is a change the product lets the agent make, such as adding an entry or opening a screen. Adding and editing happen at once.

requirements.text: The agent changes the app only through actions the product defines, never by writing SQL.
An action makes its change the way the app's own screens make it, with the same checks, and the change shows at once wherever that data shows.
The agent makes a change only when the user asked for it; a change it thinks of itself, it proposes and waits.
An action that adds or edits happens at once.

history.text: An action that adds or edits happens at once, and shows in the chat as what changed, with a way to open it in the app and an undo.
history.reason: Adds and edits need no undo. Slackened so a product can meet it with what it already has.

requirements.text: An action makes all of its change or none of it, and one that fails tells the agent why.
The agent can open a screen or an item in the app for the user.
